q: पृथ्वी किस तिथि को 'उपसौर' (Perihelion — सूर्य से अपनी निकटतम कक्षीय स्थिति, ~14.7 करोड़ किमी) पर पहुँचती है?
e: Earth reaches Perihelion (उपसौर) around 3 January and Aphelion (अपसौर, farthest ~152 million km) around 4 July. Exam Boosters: (1) Vernal Equinox: 21 March; Autumnal Equinox: 23 September (equal day and night globally); (2) Summer Solstice (NH): 21 June; Winter Solstice (NH): 22 December.
qe: On which date does the Earth reach 'Perihelion' (its closest orbital position to the Sun, ~147 million km)?

q: कौन-सी दो गैसें मिलकर पृथ्वी के वायुमंडल की शुष्क वायु का लगभग 99% भाग बनाती हैं?
e: Dry atmosphere consists of ~78.08% Nitrogen (N₂) and ~20.95% Oxygen (O₂) ≈ 99.03%, followed by Argon (~0.93%) and CO₂ (~0.04%) (नाइट्रोजन ~78% और ऑक्सीजन ~21%).
qe: Which two gases together make up approximately 99% of the dry air in the Earth's atmosphere?

q: 'रिंग ऑफ फायर' (अग्नि वलय), जिसमें विश्व के 75% से अधिक सक्रिय ज्वालामुखी और भूकंप क्षेत्र स्थित हैं, किस महासागर के चारों ओर फैला है?
e: The Circum-Pacific Belt ('Ring of Fire') encircles the Pacific Ocean along convergent subduction plate margins (प्रशांत महासागर के चारों ओर रिंग ऑफ फायर स्थित है). Exam Boosters: (1) Mount Stromboli (Italy, Mediterranean) is called the 'Lighthouse of the Mediterranean'; (2) Mount Cotopaxi (Ecuador) and Ojos del Salado (Andes) are among the highest active volcanoes.
qe: The 'Ring of Fire', an active horseshoe-shaped seismic and volcanic belt containing over 75% of the world's active volcanoes, encircles which ocean?

q: ब्लॉक पर्वत (हॉर्स्ट) और भ्रंश घाटियाँ (ग्राबेन) — जैसे यूरोप में वॉस्जेस, ब्लैक फॉरेस्ट और राइन घाटी — मुख्य रूप से किस प्रक्रिया द्वारा निर्मित होती हैं?
o: Faulting due to tensional crustal forces
e: Tensional forces fracture the Earth's crust into faults; uplifted blocks form Horsts (Block Mountains) and subsided blocks form Grabens (Rift Valleys) (तनाव बल से भ्रंशन द्वारा ब्लॉक पर्वत व भ्रंश घाटी बनती है). Exam Boosters: (1) Young Fold Mountains: Himalayas, Alps, Rockies, Andes; (2) Old Fold Mountains: Aravalli, Appalachians, Urals.
qe: Block Mountains (Horsts) and Rift Valleys (Grabens) — such as the Vosges, Black Forest, and Rhine Valley in Europe — are created primarily by:
oe: Faulting due to tensional crustal forces

q: रेतीले मरुस्थलों में पवन द्वारा निर्मित अर्धचंद्राकार बालुका स्तूप, जिनके दोनों सींग पवन की दिशा में आगे की ओर होते हैं, क्या कहलाते हैं?
e: Barchans (बरखान) are crescent-shaped mobile sand dunes formed where sand supply is moderate and wind direction is fairly constant. Exam Boosters: (1) Seif dunes are long longitudinal knife-edged dunes; (2) Loess is fine wind-blown silt deposit (famous Loess Plateau in China).
qe: Crescent-shaped sand dunes formed by wind in sandy deserts, with their horns pointing downwind, are called:

q: दक्षिणी गोलार्ध में 40° दक्षिणी से 50° दक्षिणी अक्षांशों के बीच बहने वाली तीव्र, सतत पछुआ पवनों को नाविकों द्वारा क्या कहा जाता है?
e: Due to minimal landmass friction in the Southern Hemisphere, Westerlies blow fiercely and are nicknamed 'Roaring Forties' (40°S — गरजता चालीसा), 'Furious Fifties' (50°S — प्रचंड पचासा), and 'Shrieking Sixties' (60°S — चीखता साठा). Exam Boosters: (1) Doldrums = Equatorial low-pressure calm belt (5°N–5°S); (2) Horse Latitudes = Subtropical high-pressure belts (~30°N & 30°S).
qe: What are the strong, persistent westerly winds blowing between 40° S and 50° S latitudes in the Southern Hemisphere famously called by sailors?

q: उत्तरी प्रशांत महासागर में जापान के पूर्वी तट के साथ उत्तर की ओर बहने वाली गर्म महासागरीय जलधारा (अटलांटिक की गल्फ स्ट्रीम के समतुल्य) कौन-सी है?
e: The warm Kuroshio Current (Japan Current / Black Stream) flows northward along Japan, meeting the cold Oyashio Current near Hokkaido to create rich fishing grounds (क्यूरोशियो गर्म जलधारा है).
qe: Which warm ocean current flows northward along the eastern coast of Japan in the North Pacific Ocean (analogous to the Gulf Stream in the Atlantic)?

q: चार्ल्स डार्विन के प्रवाल भित्ति निर्माण के 'अवतलन सिद्धांत' (Subsidence Theory) में प्रवाल भित्तियों के विकास का सही क्रम क्या है?
e: According to Darwin (1842), as a volcanic island gradually subsides, a Fringing Reef (तटीय प्रवाल भित्ति) evolves into a Barrier Reef (अवरोधक प्रवाल भित्ति) and finally into a ring-shaped Atoll (प्रवाल वलय) enclosing a lagoon. Exam Boosters: (1) Great Barrier Reef (NE Australia, Queensland) is the world's largest coral reef system; (2) Lakshadweep Islands are coral atolls.
qe: In Charles Darwin's 'Subsidence Theory' of Coral Reef formation, what is the correct evolutionary sequence of coral reef types?

q: गहरे महासागरीय नितल से ऊपर उठे चपटे शीर्ष वाले जलमग्न ज्वालामुखी पर्वतों को क्या कहा जाता है?
e: Flat-topped submerged seamounts (flattened earlier by wave erosion at sea level before subsiding) are called Guyots (निमग्न द्वीप / गयॉट). Exam Boosters: (1) Mariana Trench (Challenger Deep, ~10,984 m, Pacific Ocean) is the deepest oceanic trench; (2) Mid-Atlantic Ridge is the longest underwater mountain chain (divergent plate boundary).
qe: Flat-topped submerged volcanic seamounts rising from the deep ocean floor are termed:

q: नदी के मध्य और निचले मार्ग में बाढ़ के दौरान जब एक घुमावदार विसर्प (meander) मुख्य धारा से कटकर अलग हो जाता है, तो कौन-सी स्थलाकृति बनती है?
e: Cut-off meander loops form crescent-shaped 'Ox-bow lakes' (गोखुर झील / छाड़न झील, e.g., Kanwar Lake in Bihar). Exam Boosters: (1) V-shaped valleys, gorges, waterfalls, and potholes form in the youthful (upper) stage; (2) Floodplains, levees, meanders, and ox-bow lakes form in the mature stage; (3) Deltas form in the old (lower) stage.
qe: In the middle and lower courses of a river, when a pronounced river meander loop is cut off from the main channel during floods, what landform is created?

q:
उष्णकटिबंधीय चक्रवातों और शीतोष्ण चक्रवातों की तुलना के संदर्भ में निम्नलिखित कथनों पर विचार कीजिए:
कथन I: उष्णकटिबंधीय चक्रवात केवल गर्म महासागरीय जल (>26.5°C) पर उत्पन्न होते हैं और इनमें शांत 'नेत्र' (Eye) होता है, जबकि शीतोष्ण चक्रवात वाताग्रों (fronts) के सहारे स्थल व जल दोनों पर बनते हैं।
कथन II: उत्तरी गोलार्ध में उष्णकटिबंधीय चक्रवात के निम्न दाब केंद्र के चारों ओर पवनें दक्षिणावर्त (clockwise) घूमती हैं।
उपर्युक्त कथनों में से कौन-सा/से सही है/हैं?
e: Statement I is correct. Statement II is INCORRECT because in the Northern Hemisphere, cyclonic winds blow ANTI-CLOCKWISE (वामावर्त) around a low-pressure center (and clockwise in the Southern Hemisphere) (उत्तरी गोलार्ध में चक्रवात वामावर्त घूमते हैं).
qe:
Consider the following statements comparing Tropical Cyclones and Temperate (Extra-Tropical) Cyclones:
Statement I: Tropical cyclones originate exclusively over warm ocean waters (>26.5°C) and have a calm central 'Eye', whereas temperate cyclones form along polar fronts over both land and sea.
Statement II: In the Northern Hemisphere, winds circulate clockwise around the low-pressure center of a tropical cyclone.
Which of the above statements is/are correct?

q: प्रशांत महासागर में प्रबल 'अल नीनो' (El Niño) घटना के दौरान कौन-सी असामान्य महासागरीय-वायुमंडलीय स्थिति उत्पन्न होती है?
o: Unusual cooling of the eastern equatorial Pacific near Peru
Unusual warming of surface waters in the central and eastern equatorial Pacific accompanied by weakening of trade winds
Strengthening of the cold Humboldt Current off South America
Complete reversal of Earth's magnetic field
e: El Niño involves abnormal warming of the eastern/central Pacific (Peru–Ecuador coast) with weakened trade winds (negative Southern Oscillation Index), often causing drought in India/Australia and floods in Peru (पूर्वी प्रशांत महासागर का असामान्य रूप से गर्म होना). Exam Boosters: (1) La Niña is the opposite cold phase, generally bringing above-normal monsoon rains to India.
qe: During a strong 'El Niño' event in the Pacific Ocean, which abnormal oceanic-atmospheric pattern occurs?
oe: Unusual cooling of the eastern equatorial Pacific near Peru
Unusual warming of surface waters in the central and eastern equatorial Pacific accompanied by weakening of trade winds
Strengthening of the cold Humboldt Current off South America
Complete reversal of Earth's magnetic field

q: समस्थिति (Isostasy) के एयरी सिद्धांत (1855) बनाम प्राट सिद्धांत के बीच कौन-सा अंतर सटीक है?
o: Airy's theory applies only to ocean trenches, not continents.
Airy assumed uniform depth of compensation, whereas Pratt proposed deeper roots beneath mountains.
Both Airy and Pratt rejected the concept of crustal equilibrium.
Airy assumed uniform density with varying depths of roots ("root hypothesis"), whereas Pratt assumed varying densities with a uniform depth of compensation.
e: George Airy proposed "uniform density with varying thickness" (like icebergs floating in water — taller mountains have deeper roots), while J. H. Pratt proposed "varying density with uniform depth of compensation" (एयरी: समान घनत्व-विभिन्न गहराई; प्राट: विभिन्न घनत्व-समान क्षतिपूर्ति तल).
qe: According to Airy's Theory of Isostasy (1855) vs Pratt's Theory of Isostasy, which distinction is accurate?
oe: Airy's theory applies only to ocean trenches, not continents.
Airy assumed uniform depth of compensation, whereas Pratt proposed deeper roots beneath mountains.
Both Airy and Pratt rejected the concept of crustal equilibrium.
Airy assumed uniform density with varying depths of roots ("root hypothesis"), whereas Pratt assumed varying densities with a uniform depth of compensation.

q: निम्नलिखित में से किस भूगर्भीय महाकल्प को 'सरीसृपों / डायनासोर का युग' कहा जाता है?
e: The Mesozoic Era (मध्यजीवी महाकल्प — Triassic, Jurassic, Cretaceous periods) is called the Age of Reptiles/Dinosaurs; Cenozoic Era is the Age of Mammals (मेसोज़ोइक महाकल्प सरीसृपों का युग है).
qe: Which of the following geological eras is known as the 'Age of Reptiles / Dinosaurs'?

q: किसे 'आधुनिक मानव भूगोल का जनक' माना जाता है और जिन्होंने आधारभूत ग्रंथ 'एंथ्रोपोज्योग्राफी' (Anthropogeographie) लिखा?
e: German geographer Friedrich Ratzel (1844–1904) founded Human Geography ('Anthropogeographie') and Political Geography (concept of 'Lebensraum') (फ्रेडरिक रैटजेल मानव भूगोल के जनक हैं). Exam Boosters: (1) Alexander von Humboldt wrote 'Kosmos'; (2) Carl Ritter wrote 'Erdkunde'.
qe: Who is regarded as the 'Father of Modern Human Geography' and authored the foundational work 'Anthropogeographie'?

q:
निम्नलिखित जनजातियों को उनके पारंपरिक निवास क्षेत्रों से सुमेलित कीजिए:
1. बद्दू (बेडोइन) — (a) अरब मरुस्थल
2. खिरगीज — (b) मध्य एशियाई स्टेपीज़
3. सेमांग — (c) मलेशियाई वर्षावन
4. माओरी — (d) न्यूज़ीलैंड
e: Bedouin — Arabian Desert; Kirghiz (live in circular felt tents called 'Yurts') — Central Asia; Semang — Malaysia; Maori — New Zealand. Correct match: 1-a, 2-b, 3-c, 4-d.
qe:
Match the following nomadic/indigenous tribes with their traditional regions:
1. Bedouin — (a) Arabian Desert
2. Kirghiz — (b) Central Asian Steppes (Kyrgyzstan/Pamirs)
3. Semang — (c) Malaysian Rainforests
4. Maori — (d) New Zealand

q: किसी देश के आयु-लिंग जनसंख्या पिरामिड में 'चौड़ा आधार और संकरा शीर्ष' (विस्तृत त्रिभुजाकार आकृति) क्या दर्शाता है?
o: Low birth rate and ageing population
High birth rate and high proportion of young dependent population
Zero infant mortality and declining youth share
e: An expansive triangular pyramid (typical of developing countries in Stage II of DTM) reflects high birth rates and a large youthful population (उच्च जन्म दर और युवा जनसंख्या का अधिक अनुपात). Exam Boosters: (1) Bell-shaped pyramid (Australia/USA) = stable/constant population; (2) Urn/Constrictive pyramid (Japan/Germany) = declining population with narrow base.
qe: In a country's Age-Sex Population Pyramid, a 'Broad Base and Narrow Top' (expansive triangular shape) indicates:
oe: Low birth rate and ageing population
High birth rate and high proportion of young dependent population
Zero infant mortality and declining youth share

q: वॉल्टर क्रिस्टालर के 'केंद्रीय स्थल सिद्धांत' (1933) में तीन पदानुक्रम मान k = 3, k = 4 तथा k = 7 क्रमशः किसे दर्शाते हैं?
o: Administrative principle, Marketing principle, Transport principle
Marketing principle, Transport principle, Administrative principle
Transport principle, Administrative principle, Marketing principle
Industrial principle, Agricultural principle, Service principle
e: In Christaller's hexagonal Central Place hierarchy: k = 3 is the Marketing Principle (बाजार सिद्धांत), k = 4 is the Transport Principle (परिवहन सिद्धांत), and k = 7 is the Administrative Principle (प्रशासनिक सिद्धांत).
qe: In Walter Christaller's 'Central Place Theory' (1933), what do the three hierarchy values k = 3, k = 4, and k = 7 represent respectively?
oe: Administrative principle, Marketing principle, Transport principle
Marketing principle, Transport principle, Administrative principle
Transport principle, Administrative principle, Marketing principle
Industrial principle, Agricultural principle, Service principle

q: 'प्रमुख नगर का नियम' (Law of the Primate City, 1939) किसने प्रतिपादित किया, जिसके अनुसार किसी देश का सबसे बड़ा नगर दूसरे सबसे बड़े नगर से असंगत रूप से (अक्सर दोगुने से भी) बड़ा होता है?
e: Mark Jefferson proposed the Law of the Primate City (1939) (e.g., Bangkok in Thailand, Paris in France) (मार्क जेफरसन ने प्रमुख नगर का नियम दिया). Exam Boosters: (1) G. K. Zipf gave the 'Rank-Size Rule' (1949): P_r = P₁ / r; (2) Homer Hoyt gave the Sector Model (1939); (3) Harris & Ullman gave the Multiple Nuclei Model (1945).
qe: Who formulated the 'Law of the Primate City' (1939), observing that a country's leading city is disproportionately larger (often more than twice as large) than the second-largest city?

q: निम्नलिखित में से कौन-सा ग्रामीण-से-शहरी प्रवास को प्रेरित करने वाला 'आकर्षण कारक' (Pull Factor) के बजाय 'प्रतिकर्ष कारक' (Push Factor) है?
o: Better healthcare and higher wages in cities
Agricultural distress, droughts, and lack of local employment in villages
Availability of higher education universities in metros
e: Push factors compel people to leave their place of origin (unemployment, droughts, poverty, conflict), whereas Pull factors attract them to destinations (jobs, security, amenities) (प्रतिकर्ष कारक: सूखा, बेरोजगारी व कृषि संकट).
qe: Which of the following is a 'Push Factor' rather than a 'Pull Factor' driving rural-to-urban migration?
oe: Better healthcare and higher wages in cities
Agricultural distress, droughts, and lack of local employment in villages
Availability of higher education universities in metros

q: 1970 के दशक में कौन-सा भौगोलिक दृष्टिकोण (डेविड हार्वे और रिचर्ड पीट के नेतृत्व में) उभरा, जिसने स्थानिक असमानता, गरीबी और पूँजीवाद की आलोचना हेतु मार्क्सवादी संरचनात्मक विश्लेषण का उपयोग किया?
e: Radical Geography (उग्रवादी/क्रांतिकारी भूगोल, journal 'Antipode', 1969 — David Harvey's 'Social Justice and the City', 1973) arose in reaction to the Quantitative Revolution to address social inequality and class structures. Exam Boosters: (1) Yi-Fu Tuan championed Humanistic Geography ('Topophilia'); (2) Julian Wolpert and Allan Pred contributed to Behavioural Geography.
qe: Which geographical paradigm emerged in the 1970s (led by David Harvey and Richard Peet) using Marxist structural analysis to critique spatial inequality, poverty, and capitalism?

q: 1990 में अर्थशास्त्री महबूब उल हक (अमर्त्य सेन के सहयोग से) द्वारा प्रारंभ और UNDP द्वारा प्रकाशित 'मानव विकास सूचकांक' (HDI) किन तीन आयामों का गुणोत्तर माध्य है?
o: Literacy rate, Forest cover, and Total GDP
Infant mortality, Industrial output, and Military expenditure
Life expectancy at birth, Education (Mean & Expected years of schooling), and GNI per capita (PPP)
Birth rate, Urbanization rate, and Foreign exchange reserves
e: HDI combines three dimensions: Health (Life expectancy at birth), Knowledge (Mean years of schooling + Expected years of schooling), and Decent Standard of Living (GNI per capita in PPP $) (स्वास्थ्य, शिक्षा और प्रति व्यक्ति सकल राष्ट्रीय आय).
qe: The 'Human Development Index (HDI)', introduced in 1990 by Pakistani economist Mahbub ul Haq (with Amartya Sen) and published by UNDP, is a geometric mean of which three dimensions?
oe: Literacy rate, Forest cover, and Total GDP
Infant mortality, Industrial output, and Military expenditure
Life expectancy at birth, Education (Mean & Expected years of schooling), and GNI per capita (PPP)
Birth rate, Urbanization rate, and Foreign exchange reserves

q: निम्नलिखित में से कौन-सा देश विश्व में प्राकृतिक रबर (Natural Rubber) का सबसे बड़ा उत्पादक और निर्यातक है?
e: Thailand is the world's leading producer and exporter of natural rubber (followed by Indonesia and Vietnam), while Kerala is India's largest rubber-producing state (थाईलैंड विश्व में प्राकृतिक रबर का सबसे बड़ा उत्पादक है).
qe: Which country is the world's largest producer and exporter of Natural Rubber (and earlier along with Malaysia formed the world's rubber belt in Southeast Asia)?

q: विशाल ऑटोमोबाइल विनिर्माण क्लस्टर के कारण किस भारतीय शहर को (अमेरिका के डेट्रॉयट के नाम पर) 'भारत का डेट्रॉयट' कहा जाता है?
e: Chennai (Tamil Nadu) is called the 'Detroit of India' (चेन्नई को भारत का डेट्रॉयट कहा जाता है). Exam Boosters: (1) Pittsburgh (USA) — Iron & Steel Capital; (2) Osaka — 'Manchester of Japan'; (3) Bengaluru — 'Silicon Valley of India'; (4) Surat — 'Diamond City of India'.
qe: Which city is famously nicknamed the 'Detroit of India' (after Detroit, USA — the automobile capital) due to its massive automobile manufacturing cluster?

q: ओपेक (OPEC — पेट्रोलियम निर्यातक देशों का संगठन, स्थापना 1960 बगदाद) का मुख्यालय कहाँ स्थित है?
e: OPEC's headquarters has been in Vienna, Austria since 1965 (ओपेक का मुख्यालय वियना, ऑस्ट्रिया में है). Exam Boosters: (1) Five founding members of OPEC (1960): Iran, Iraq, Kuwait, Saudi Arabia, and Venezuela.
qe: Where is the headquarters of OPEC (Organization of the Petroleum Exporting Countries, founded in Baghdad in 1960) located?

q: विश्व का सबसे व्यस्त महासागरीय व्यापार मार्ग कौन-सा है, जो विश्व के दो सर्वाधिक औद्योगिक रूप से उन्नत क्षेत्रों — पश्चिमी यूरोप और पूर्वी उत्तरी अमेरिका — को जोड़ता है?
o: North Atlantic Sea Route ('Big Trunk Route')
e: The North Atlantic Sea Route (nicknamed the 'Big Trunk Route') handles over one-fourth of global foreign maritime trade (उत्तरी अटलांटिक समुद्री मार्ग विश्व का सबसे व्यस्त जलमार्ग है).
qe: Which is the busiest ocean trade route in the world, connecting the two most industrially advanced regions — Western Europe and Eastern North America?
oe: North Atlantic Sea Route ('Big Trunk Route')

q: कौन-से यूरोपीय देश (विशेषकर डेनमार्क और नीदरलैंड) अत्यधिक यंत्रीकृत सहकारी 'वाणिज्यिक डेयरी कृषि' के लिए विश्व-प्रसिद्ध हैं?
e: North-Western Europe (Denmark, Netherlands, UK, Ireland) along with New Zealand and the US/Canadian Great Lakes belt are the world's premier Commercial Dairy Farming zones (उत्तर-पश्चिमी यूरोप).
qe: Which European countries (especially Denmark and the Netherlands) are world-renowned for highly mechanized cooperative 'Commercial Dairy Farming'?

q: आर्थिक भूगोल की सबसे प्रसिद्ध पेट्रोलियम पाइपलाइनों में से एक 'बिग इंच' (Big Inch) पाइपलाइन मेक्सिको की खाड़ी के तेल क्षेत्रों से किस देश के उत्तर-पूर्वी राज्यों को तेल पहुँचाती है?
e: The 'Big Inch' pipeline in the USA carries petroleum from Texas (Gulf of Mexico) to the industrial north-eastern states (बिग इंच पाइपलाइन संयुक्त राज्य अमेरिका में है). Exam Boosters: (1) India's famous HVJ (Hazira–Vijaipur–Jagdishpur) gas pipeline is operated by GAIL.
qe: The 'Big Inch' pipeline — one of the most famous petroleum pipelines in economic geography — transports oil from the Gulf of Mexico oilfields to the north-eastern states of which country?

q: पाँच-क्षेत्रीय आर्थिक वर्गीकरण में वरिष्ठ कॉर्पोरेट अधिकारी, सरकारी नीति-निर्माता और शीर्ष अनुसंधान वैज्ञानिक किस क्षेत्र के अंतर्गत आते हैं?
e: Quinary activities (पंचम क्रियाकलाप / 'Gold-Collar' professions) involve highest-level decision-making, policy formulation, and executive leadership (Quaternary = information/R&D; Tertiary = services; Secondary = manufacturing; Primary = extraction).
qe: In the 5-sector economic classification, senior corporate executives, government policymakers, and top research scientists belong to which sector?

q: पनामा नहर अपने मध्य भाग में किस कृत्रिम मीठे पानी की झील को पार करने के लिए जहाजों को समुद्र तल से ~26 मीटर ऊपर उठाने हेतु जलीय लॉक प्रणाली का उपयोग करती है?
e: Ships transiting the 82-km Panama Canal (Colon on Atlantic to Panama City on Pacific) are raised via locks to cross artificial Gatun Lake (गाटुन झील, पनामा नहर).
qe: The Panama Canal utilizes a series of hydraulic locks to lift ships ~26 metres above sea level to cross which artificial freshwater lake in its central stretch?

q: विश्व के निम्नलिखित प्रमुख खनिज/औद्योगिक क्षेत्रों और उनके देशों का कौन-सा युग्म सही सुमेलित नहीं है?
e: Kuzbas (Kuznetsk Basin) is one of the largest coal-mining basins in RUSSIA (Siberia), NOT Germany (कुज़बास कोयला क्षेत्र रूस में स्थित है, जर्मनी में नहीं).
qe: Which of the following pairs of major mineral/industrial regions of the world and their countries is NOT correctly matched?

q: 'विटिकल्चर' (वाइन हेतु वाणिज्यिक अंगूर की खेती) और 'जैतून की खेती' किस जलवायु क्षेत्र की प्रमुख कृषि विशेषताएँ हैं?
e: The Mediterranean region (Italy, France, Spain, California, Central Chile, SW Australia) is known as the 'Orchard Lands of the World' for viticulture, olives, figs, and citrus fruits (भूमध्यसागरीय क्षेत्र).
qe: 'Viticulture' (commercial grape cultivation for wine) and 'Olive cultivation' are hallmark agricultural specializations of which climatic region?

q: भारतीय संघ का सबसे दक्षिणी बिंदु (जो ग्रेट निकोबार द्वीप में 6°45' उत्तरी अक्षांश पर स्थित है) कौन-सा है?
e: Indira Point (Great Nicobar, 6°45' N) is the southernmost point of India; Kanyakumari (8°4' N) is the southernmost point of the Indian mainland (इंदिरा पॉइंट भारत का दक्षिणतम बिंदु है). Exam Boosters: (1) Northernmost point: Indira Col (Ladakh); (2) Easternmost: Kibithu (Arunachal Pradesh); (3) Westernmost: Guhar Moti / Sir Creek (Gujarat).
qe: Which is the southernmost point of the Indian Union (located in Great Nicobar Island at 6°45' N latitude)?

q: भारत की सबसे प्राचीन अवशिष्ट वलित पर्वत शृंखला कौन-सी है, जो गुजरात से राजस्थान और हरियाणा होते हुए दिल्ली तक फैली है?
e: The Aravalli Range (Precambrian era, highest peak Guru Shikhar at 1,722 m in Mount Abu) is India's oldest fold mountain range (अरावली भारत की सबसे प्राचीन वलित पर्वत शृंखला है).
qe: Which is the oldest residual fold mountain range in India, stretching from Gujarat through Rajasthan and Haryana to Delhi?

q: असम में स्थित भारत का सबसे पुराना संचालित कच्चा तेल क्षेत्र और रिफाइनरी (1889 में खोजा गया, 1901 में रिफाइनरी शुरू) कौन-सा है?
e: Digboi (Tinsukia district, Assam) is India's oldest oilfield and Asia's oldest operating oil refinery (डिगबोई, असम भारत का सबसे पुराना तेल क्षेत्र है). Exam Boosters: (1) Mumbai High (offshore Arabian Sea, 1974) is India's largest offshore oilfield; (2) Jamnagar Refinery (Gujarat) is the world's largest single-location refining complex.
qe: Which is India's oldest operating crude oil refinery and oilfield (discovered in 1889, refinery commissioned in 1901) located in Assam?

q: भारत में सर्वाधिक भौगोलिक क्षेत्रफल पर किस प्रकार की प्राकृतिक वनस्पति (सागौन, साल, शीशम, चंदन प्रधान) पाई जाती है?
e: Tropical Deciduous (Monsoon) Forests — subdivided into Moist Deciduous (100–200 cm rain) and Dry Deciduous (70–100 cm rain) — are the most widespread forests in India (उष्णकटिबंधीय पर्णपाती / मानसूनी वन).
qe: Which type of natural vegetation covers the largest geographical area in India (dominated by Teak, Sal, Shisham, and Sandalwood)?

q: 1960 की सिंधु जल संधि (विश्व बैंक की मध्यस्थता में भारत-पाकिस्तान के बीच) के अंतर्गत किन तीन 'पूर्वी नदियों' के जल के उपयोग का अनन्य अधिकार भारत को दिया गया?
e: Under the Indus Waters Treaty (19 Sept 1960), India received unrestricted use of the 3 Eastern Rivers — Ravi, Beas, and Sutlej — while Pakistan received the 3 Western Rivers — Indus, Jhelum, and Chenab (रावी, ब्यास और सतलुज का अधिकार भारत को मिला).
qe: Under the Indus Waters Treaty (1960, brokered by the World Bank between India and Pakistan), exclusive usage rights over which three 'Eastern Rivers' were allocated to India?

q: स्वतंत्र भारत की प्रथम बहुउद्देशीय नदी घाटी परियोजना के रूप में 1948 में स्थापित दामोदर घाटी निगम (DVC) किस विदेशी परियोजना के मॉडल पर आधारित था?
e: DVC (1948, covering Jharkhand and West Bengal — Tilaiya, Konar, Maithon, Panchet dams) was modelled on the Tennessee Valley Authority (TVA) of the USA (अमेरिका की टेनेसी घाटी परियोजना पर आधारित).
qe: The Damodar Valley Corporation (DVC), established in 1948 as independent India's first multipurpose river valley project, was modelled on which foreign project?

q: मध्य प्रदेश, राजस्थान और उत्तर प्रदेश में बहने वाली कौन-सी नदी तीव्र अवनालिका अपरदन (gully erosion) द्वारा विस्तृत 'उत्खात भूमि / बीहड़' बनाने के लिए प्रसिद्ध है?
e: The Chambal River (origin: Janapav hills near Mhow, MP; major tributary of Yamuna) creates extensive ravines/badlands (चंबल नदी अवनालिका अपरदन व बीहड़ के लिए प्रसिद्ध है). Exam Boosters: (1) Gandhi Sagar, Rana Pratap Sagar, and Jawahar Sagar dams are built on the Chambal.
qe: Which river in Madhya Pradesh, Rajasthan, and Uttar Pradesh is famous for severe gully erosion forming extensive 'Badland Topography' (Chambal Ravines / बीहड़)?

q: भारत के पश्चिमी तटीय मैदान के दक्षिणी भाग (केरल के साथ, जो 'कयाल' या पश्चजल के लिए प्रसिद्ध है) को क्या कहा जाता है?
e: Western Coastal Plain segments (North to South): Konkan (Maharashtra–Goa) → Kanara/Karavali (Karnataka) → Malabar (Kerala, famous for Vembanad & Ashtamudi backwaters/kayals). Eastern Coast: Utkal (Odisha) → Northern Circars → Coromandel (Tamil Nadu) (केरल का तट मालाबार तट कहलाता है).
qe: What is the southern section of India's Western Coastal Plain (along Kerala, famous for 'Kayals' or backwaters) called?

q: नेवेली (तमिलनाडु) भारत में किस प्रकार के कोयले का सबसे बड़ा खुली खदान (open-cast) भंडार है?
e: Neyveli (Tamil Nadu) accounts for the majority of India's Lignite (लिग्नाइट / भूरा कोयला) production (used in thermal power). Exam Boosters: (1) Jharia (Jharkhand) is India's premier source of prime coking Bituminous coal; (2) Coal quality order (highest to lowest carbon): Anthracite > Bituminous > Lignite > Peat.
qe: Neyveli (in Tamil Nadu) is India's largest open-cast mining reserve of which type of coal?

q:
कोंकण रेलवे (1998 में प्रारंभ) के संदर्भ में निम्नलिखित कथनों पर विचार कीजिए:
कथन I: यह दुर्गम पश्चिमी घाट तट के सहारे गोवा होते हुए रोहा (महाराष्ट्र) को मंगलुरु/थोकुर (कर्नाटक) से जोड़ती है।
कथन II: यह पूर्णतः समतल जलोढ़ मैदानों पर निर्मित भारत का प्रथम हाई-स्पीड बुलेट ट्रेन गलियारा है।
उपर्युक्त कथनों में से कौन-सा/से सही है/हैं?
e: Statement I is correct (~756 km engineering marvel traversing 91 tunnels and 2,000+ bridges across the Western Ghats). Statement II is incorrect (India's first bullet train corridor is Mumbai–Ahmedabad).
qe:
Consider the following statements regarding the Konkan Railway (opened 1998):
Statement I: It runs along the rugged Western Ghats coast connecting Roha (Maharashtra) to Mangalore/Thokur (Karnataka) via Goa.
Statement II: It is India's first high-speed bullet train corridor built on completely flat alluvial plains.
Which of the above statements is/are correct?

q: भारत के निम्नलिखित बायोस्फीयर रिज़र्व और उनके राज्यों का कौन-सा युग्म सही सुमेलित नहीं है?
e: Dibru-Saikhowa Biosphere Reserve is located in ASSAM (on the Brahmaputra floodplain), NOT Arunachal Pradesh (डिब्रू-सैखोवा असम में है; अरुणाचल प्रदेश में दिहांग-दिबांग बायोस्फीयर रिज़र्व है). Exam Boosters: (1) India has 18 Biosphere Reserves, of which 12 are in UNESCO's MAB (Man and the Biosphere) World Network.
qe: Which of the following pairs of Indian Biosphere Reserves and their states is NOT correctly matched?

q: मध्य भारत में कौन-सी पर्वत शृंखला नर्मदा नदी बेसिन और तापी नदी बेसिन के बीच प्रमुख जल-विभाजक का कार्य करती है?
e: Moving North to South in Central India: Vindhya Range → Narmada Rift Valley → Satpura Range → Tapi Rift Valley → Ajanta/Satmala Hills (सतपुड़ा शृंखला नर्मदा और तापी के बीच स्थित है).
qe: Which mountain range acts as a major water divide between the Narmada River basin and the Tapi River basin in Central India?

q: भारत की जनगणना 2011 में किस राज्य में उसकी कुल जनसंख्या के अनुपात में अनुसूचित जाति (SC) का प्रतिशत (~31.9%) सर्वाधिक था?
e: Punjab recorded the highest SC population percentage (31.9%), whereas Uttar Pradesh had the largest absolute SC population (~4.13 crore) (प्रतिशत में सर्वाधिक SC पंजाब में तथा कुल संख्या में सर्वाधिक उत्तर प्रदेश में). Exam Boosters: (1) Highest ST population by absolute number: Madhya Pradesh; Highest ST by percentage among states: Mizoram (~94.4%).
qe: In India's Census 2011, which state had the highest percentage of Scheduled Caste (SC) population relative to its total state population (~31.9%)?

q: किस प्राचीन यूनानी दार्शनिक ने राजनीति विज्ञान को 'सर्वोच्च विज्ञान' (Master Science) कहा क्योंकि यह अन्य सभी विज्ञानों को सर्वोच्च मानवीय कल्याण की ओर निर्देशित करता है?
e: Aristotle (in 'Nicomachean Ethics') called Political Science the 'Master Science' (अरस्तू ने राजनीति विज्ञान को सर्वोच्च विज्ञान कहा).
qe: Which ancient Greek philosopher called Political Science the 'Master Science' (Architectonic Science) because it governs all other sciences toward the supreme human good?

q: निम्नलिखित में से कौन 'राज्य' (State) और 'सरकार' (Government) के बीच सही अंतर दर्शाता है?
o: The State is a permanent, abstract sovereign entity, whereas Government is its temporary, concrete agency exercising state power.
Government is permanent while the State changes after every election.
Both State and Government mean the exact same institution.
Only the Government possesses territory, not the State.
e: State is permanent, sovereign, and encompasses all citizens; Government is only one of the four elements of the State — a temporary agency that can change via elections (राज्य स्थायी व संप्रभु है, सरकार उसकी अस्थायी संस्था है).
qe: Which of the following correctly distinguishes a 'State' from a 'Government'?
oe: The State is a permanent, abstract sovereign entity, whereas Government is its temporary, concrete agency exercising state power.
Government is permanent while the State changes after every election.
Both State and Government mean the exact same institution.
Only the Government possesses territory, not the State.

q: राज्य की उत्पत्ति के 'पितृसत्तात्मक सिद्धांत' (Patriarchal Theory) के प्रमुख प्रतिपादक कौन हैं, जिन्होंने इसे अपनी पुस्तक 'एंशिएंट लॉ' (1861) में प्रस्तुत किया?
e: Sir Henry Maine ('Ancient Law', 1861) argued that the State evolved from the patriarchal family headed by the eldest male (सर हेनरी मेन पितृसत्तात्मक सिद्धांत के प्रवर्तक हैं). Exam Boosters: (1) Edward Jenks and Morgan advocated the Matriarchal Theory; (2) Franz Oppenheimer ('The State') advocated the Force Theory ("War begat the king").
qe: Who is the chief exponent of the 'Patriarchal Theory' of the origin of the State, elaborated in his famous work 'Ancient Law' (1861)?

q: राजनीतिक विश्लेषण के डेविड ईस्टन के 'व्यवस्था उपागम' (इनपुट–आउटपुट मॉडल) में पर्यावरण से राजनीतिक व्यवस्था में प्रवेश करने वाले दो प्रकार के 'इनपुट' (आगत) कौन-से हैं?
e: In Easton's Input–Output model, Inputs consist of 'Demands' (माँगें) and 'Supports' (समर्थन), which the political system converts into Outputs (authoritative decisions/policies), linked back via a 'Feedback Loop' (डेविड ईस्टन का आगत-निर्गत मॉडल).
qe: In David Easton's 'Systems Approach' (Input–Output Model) to Political Analysis, what constitute the two types of 'Inputs' entering the political system from its environment?

q: 'द पॉलिटिकल सिस्टम' (1953) और 'ए फ्रेमवर्क फॉर पॉलिटिकल एनालिसिस' (1965) किसने लिखी और राजनीति को "समाज के लिए मूल्यों के आधिकारिक आवंटन" के रूप में परिभाषित किया?
e: David Easton gave this celebrated behavioural definition of politics (डेविड ईस्टन: "मूल्यों का आधिकारिक आवंटन"). Exam Boosters: (1) Gabriel Almond developed the 'Structural-Functional Approach' in comparative politics; (2) Robert Dahl developed 'Polyarchy' (Pluralist Democracy).
qe: Who authored 'The Political System' (1953) and 'A Framework for Political Analysis' (1965), defining Politics as "the authoritative allocation of values for a society"?

q: 'इंट्रोडक्शन टू द स्टडी ऑफ द लॉ ऑफ द कॉन्स्टिट्यूशन' (1885) में 'विधि के शासन' (Rule of Law) की अवधारणा को व्यवस्थित रूप से किसने प्रस्तुत किया?
e: British jurist A. V. Dicey articulated 3 pillars of Rule of Law: (1) Supremacy of Law (no arbitrary power), (2) Equality before Law, and (3) Predominance of legal spirit (ए. वी. डायसी ने विधि के शासन का सिद्धांत दिया). Exam Boosters: (1) Article 14 of the Indian Constitution ('Equality before Law') reflects Dicey's Rule of Law.
qe: Who systematically expounded the concept of 'Rule of Law' (विधि का शासन) in 'Introduction to the Study of the Law of the Constitution' (1885)?

q: निम्नलिखित में से कौन-सा प्रत्यक्ष लोकतंत्र (जो विशेष रूप से स्विट्ज़रलैंड में प्रचलित है) के चार प्रमुख उपकरणों में शामिल नहीं है?
e: The 4 instruments of Direct Democracy are Referendum, Initiative, Recall, and Plebiscite. Judicial Review is a constitutional check by courts, NOT a direct democracy instrument (न्यायिक पुनरावलोकन प्रत्यक्ष लोकतंत्र का उपकरण नहीं है).
qe: Which of the following is NOT one of the four classic instruments of Direct Democracy (practised notably in Switzerland)?

q: 'विधितः संप्रभुता' (De Jure) और 'तथ्यतः संप्रभुता' (De Facto) के बीच क्या अंतर है?
o: De Jure sovereignty is based on military coup, while De Facto is based on law.
Both terms refer exclusively to international treaties.
De Jure applies only to federal states, while De Facto applies to unitary states.
De Jure sovereignty is legally recognized by law/constitution, whereas De Facto sovereignty is actual effective control exercised in fact (e.g., after a revolution or coup) even without legal title.
e: De Jure (विधितः) = rightful sovereignty in the eyes of law; De Facto (तथ्यतः) = actual obedience-commanding power on the ground (e.g., Cromwell in England or Bolsheviks in 1917 before legal recognition). Over time, a stable De Facto sovereign tends to become De Jure.
qe: What is the distinction between 'De Jure Sovereignty' and 'De Facto Sovereignty'?
oe: De Jure sovereignty is based on military coup, while De Facto is based on law.
Both terms refer exclusively to international treaties.
De Jure applies only to federal states, while De Facto applies to unitary states.
De Jure sovereignty is legally recognized by law/constitution, whereas De Facto sovereignty is actual effective control exercised in fact (e.g., after a revolution or coup) even without legal title.

q: अधिकारों का कौन-सा सिद्धांत मानता है कि अधिकार न तो प्रकृति की देन हैं और न ही प्रथा की, बल्कि वे पूर्णतः राज्य द्वारा निर्मित हैं और केवल राज्य के कानून से लागू होते हैं?
e: The Legal Theory of Rights (supported by Bentham, Hobbes, and Austin) asserts that rights exist only when recognized and enforced by the State's law (अधिकारों का वैधानिक सिद्धांत — बेंथम व ऑस्टिन). Exam Boosters: (1) Historical Theory (Edmund Burke): rights are products of long-standing customs; (2) Social Welfare Theory (Laski, Roscoe Pound): rights are conditions of social good.
qe: Which theory of Rights holds that rights are neither created by nature nor by custom, but are strictly creations of the State and enforceable only through State law?

q: "स्वतंत्रता और समानता एक-दूसरे की विरोधी नहीं हैं, बल्कि एक-दूसरे की पूरक और एक ही आदर्श के दो पहलू हैं।" — किस विचारक समूह ने इस दृष्टिकोण का समर्थन किया?
o: Lord Acton and Alexis de Tocqueville
Harold Laski, R. H. Tawney, and C. B. Macpherson
e: Positive liberals and socialists (Laski, Tawney, Barker, Macpherson) view Liberty and Equality as complementary (स्वतंत्रता और समानता पूरक हैं), whereas Lord Acton ("The passion for equality has made vain the hope for freedom"), De Tocqueville, and Hayek view them as opposed.
qe: "Liberty and Equality are not antithetical to each other; rather they are complementary and two facets of the same ideal." — Which group of thinkers championed this view?
oe: Lord Acton and Alexis de Tocqueville
Harold Laski, R. H. Tawney, and C. B. Macpherson

q: 'समानों के साथ समान और असमानों के साथ असमान व्यवहार' यह प्रसिद्ध न्याय/समानता सूत्र किसने दिया था?
e: Aristotle formulated Proportional Equality ("Treat equals equally and unequals unequally") in 'Politics' and 'Nicomachean Ethics' (अरस्तू का आनुपातिक समानता का सिद्धांत). Exam Boosters: (1) Marx's communist principle of distribution: "From each according to his ability, to each according to his need".
qe: Who coined the distinction between 'Two Concepts of Equality' — 'Equality of Opportunity' vs 'Equality of Outcome' — and who famously wrote "Equal things to equals and unequal things to unequals"?

q: प्लेटो की 'रिपब्लिक' में मानव आत्मा के कौन-से तीन तत्व क्रमशः शासक, सैनिक (सहायक) और उत्पादक वर्ग के अनुरूप हैं?
e: Plato's tripartite soul maps Reason/Wisdom (विवेक) → Rulers, Spirit/Courage (साहस) → Auxiliaries, and Appetite/Temperance (क्षुधा/संयम) → Producers; harmony among all three produces Justice (न्याय).
qe: In Plato's 'Republic', which three elements of the human soul correspond respectively to the Rulers, Soldiers (Auxiliaries), and Producers?

q: जॉन लॉक के ज्ञान-मीमांसा दर्शन में (जिसने उनके उदारवादी राजनीतिक सिद्धांत को प्रभावित किया) लैटिन वाक्यांश 'टेबुला रासा' (Tabula Rasa) का क्या अर्थ है?
o: A 'blank slate' — the human mind at birth has no innate ideas and acquires all knowledge from experience
e: 'Tabula Rasa' means a blank slate (कोरी स्लेट), supporting Locke's empiricism and belief in natural human equality at birth (लॉक के अनुसार जन्म के समय मानव मस्तिष्क कोरी स्लेट होता है).
qe: In John Locke's epistemology (influencing his liberal political theory), what does the Latin phrase 'Tabula Rasa' (used in 'An Essay Concerning Human Understanding', 1690) mean?
oe: A 'blank slate' — the human mind at birth has no innate ideas and acquires all knowledge from experience

q: कौटिल्य के 'अर्थशास्त्र' में प्रशासन और विदेशी शत्रुओं की निगरानी हेतु राजा द्वारा नियुक्त गुप्तचरों ('गूढ़पुरुष') की दो प्रमुख श्रेणियाँ कौन-सी हैं?
e: Kautilya organized an elaborate espionage network divided into 'Samstha' (संस्था — stationary spies posted at fixed places) and 'Sanchara' (संचार — roving/wandering spies) (कौटिल्य के गुप्तचर: संस्था और संचार).
qe: In Kautilya's 'Arthashastra', what are the two main categories of spies ('Gudhapurusha') employed by the King to monitor administration and foreign rivals?

q: जीन-जैक रूसो ने यह प्रसिद्ध तर्क क्यों दिया कि अंग्रेज़ लोग "केवल संसद सदस्यों के चुनाव के समय ही स्वतंत्र होते हैं; जैसे ही वे चुन लिए जाते हैं, वे फिर से दास बन जाते हैं"?
o: Because Rousseau favoured absolute hereditary monarchy over Parliament.
Because Britain had no written constitution.
Because Rousseau held that Popular Sovereignty (General Will) cannot be represented or delegated, advocating Direct Democracy instead of Representative Democracy.
Because women could not vote in 18th-century England.
e: Rousseau argued that Sovereignty is inalienable and cannot be represented ("Sovereignty cannot be represented for the same reason that it cannot be alienated"), strongly preferring Direct Democracy (रूसो प्रतिनिधि लोकतंत्र के विरोधी व प्रत्यक्ष लोकतंत्र के समर्थक थे).
qe: Why did J. J. Rousseau argue that the English people are "free only during the election of members of Parliament; as soon as they are elected, slavery overtakes them"?
oe: Because Rousseau favoured absolute hereditary monarchy over Parliament.
Because Britain had no written constitution.
Because Rousseau held that Popular Sovereignty (General Will) cannot be represented or delegated, advocating Direct Democracy instead of Representative Democracy.
Because women could not vote in 18th-century England.

q: "राज्य का आधार शक्ति नहीं, बल्कि इच्छा है" (Will, not force, is the basis of the state) — यह प्रसिद्ध कथन किस विचारक का है, जिसने आदर्शवाद और सकारात्मक उदारवाद को जोड़ा?
e: English Oxford Idealist T. H. Green ('Lectures on the Principles of Political Obligation') wrote "Will, not force, is the basis of the state" and defined the state's role as "hindering the hindrances to the good life" (टी. एच. ग्रीन का प्रसिद्ध कथन).
qe: Which thinker wrote "Will, not force, is the basis of the state", bridging Idealism and Positive Liberalism?

q: कौन-सी राजनीतिक विचारधारा राज्य को "अनावश्यक बुराई" मानती है और राज्य तथा सभी दमनकारी राजनीतिक सत्ता के पूर्ण उन्मूलन की वकालत करती है?
e: Anarchism (अराजकतावाद — William Godwin, Pierre-Joseph Proudhon, Mikhail Bakunin, Peter Kropotkin) views the State as an unnecessary evil and promotes voluntary stateless cooperation.
qe: Which political ideology advocates the complete abolition of the State and all coercive political authority, considering the State an "unnecessary evil"?

q: किसे 'विकासवादी समाजवाद / संशोधनवाद' (Evolutionary Socialism, 1899) का जनक माना जाता है, जिन्होंने तर्क दिया कि समाजवाद हिंसक क्रांति के बजाय लोकतांत्रिक संसदीय सुधारों से प्राप्त किया जा सकता है?
e: German Marxist Eduard Bernstein ('Evolutionary Socialism', 1899) revised orthodox Marxism to advocate peaceful parliamentary Social Democracy (एडुआर्ड बर्नस्टीन संशोधनवादी/विकासवादी समाजवाद के जनक हैं).
qe: Who is regarded as the father of 'Evolutionary Socialism / Revisionism' (arguing in 'Evolutionary Socialism', 1899, that socialism can be achieved peacefully through democratic parliamentary reforms rather than violent revolution)?

q: कार्ल मार्क्स के 'अलगाव के सिद्धांत' (1844 की पांडुलिपियाँ) में पूँजीवाद के अंतर्गत एक श्रमिक कितने प्रमुख पहलुओं से अलग-थलग (alienated) हो जाता है?
e: Marx identified 4 dimensions of Alienation: alienation from (1) the Product of labour, (2) the Act/Process of production, (3) Species-being (human creative essence), and (4) Fellow workers/humanity (मार्क्स ने अलगाव के 4 रूप बताए).
qe: In Karl Marx's theory of 'Alienation' (अलगाववाद, 1844 Manuscripts), a factory worker under capitalism is alienated from how many distinct aspects?

q: अपने 1882 के प्रसिद्ध व्याख्यान 'राष्ट्र क्या है?' में किसने राष्ट्र को साझा स्मृतियों और साथ रहने की वर्तमान इच्छा पर आधारित "नित्य जनमत संग्रह" (daily plebiscite) कहा?
e: French scholar Ernest Renan defined a nation as a spiritual principle and a "daily plebiscite" (अर्नेस्ट रेनन). Exam Boosters: (1) Benedict Anderson ('Imagined Communities', 1983) defined the nation as an "imagined political community".
qe: Who defined a Nation as a "daily plebiscite" (नित्य जनमत संग्रह) rooted in shared memories and the present will to live together, in his famous 1882 lecture 'What is a Nation?'?

q: 'रिफ्लेक्शंस ऑन द रिवोल्यूशन इन फ्रांस' (1790) पुस्तक किसने लिखी और किसे 'आधुनिक रूढ़िवाद (Conservatism) का जनक' माना जाता है?
e: Edmund Burke criticized the radical French Revolution for destroying organic traditions and institutions, laying the foundations of Modern Conservatism (एडमंड बर्क आधुनिक रूढ़िवाद के जनक हैं). Exam Boosters: (1) Thomas Paine replied to Burke with 'Rights of Man' (1791).
qe: Which political philosopher authored 'Reflections on the Revolution in France' (1790) and is regarded as the 'Father of Modern Conservatism'?

q: किस ब्रिटिश अधिनियम ने भारत में ईस्ट इंडिया कंपनी के राजनीतिक मामलों के प्रबंधन हेतु 'नियंत्रण बोर्ड' (Board of Control) की स्थापना कर द्वैध नियंत्रण प्रणाली शुरू की?
e: Pitt's India Act, 1784 separated commercial and political functions of the Company and first referred to Company territories as "British possessions in India" (पिट्स इंडिया एक्ट, 1784).
qe: Which British Act created the 'Board of Control' to manage political affairs of the East India Company in India, establishing a system of Dual Control (Court of Directors for commercial, Board of Control for political affairs)?

q: किस चार्टर अधिनियम ने ईस्ट इंडिया कंपनी के व्यापारिक एकाधिकार को पूर्णतः समाप्त किया, बंगाल के गवर्नर-जनरल को 'भारत का गवर्नर-जनरल' बनाया और परिषद में विधि सदस्य (लॉर्ड मैकाले) को जोड़ा?
e: Charter Act of 1833 was the climax of centralization in British India, making Lord William Bentinck the first Governor-General of India (चार्टर अधिनियम, 1833). Exam Boosters: (1) Charter Act 1813 ended trade monopoly EXCEPT tea and trade with China, and earmarked ₹1 lakh/year for Indian education; (2) Charter Act 1853 introduced open competitive exams for Civil Services (Macaulay Committee, 1854).
qe: Which Charter Act ended the East India Company's commercial monopoly completely, made the Governor-General of Bengal the 'Governor-General of India', and added a Law Member (Lord Macaulay) to the Council?

q: किस अधिनियम ने ब्रिटिश भारत में पहली बार मुसलमानों के लिए 'पृथक निर्वाचक मंडल' की व्यवस्था की, जिसके कारण लॉर्ड मिंटो को 'सांप्रदायिक निर्वाचन का जनक' कहा गया?
e: The Indian Councils Act, 1909 (Morley-Minto Reforms) institutionalized communal representation via separate electorates and also appointed the first Indian (Satyendra Prasad Sinha) to the Viceroy's Executive Council (1909 मार्ले-मिंटो सुधार).
qe: Which Act introduced 'Separate Electorates' for Muslims in British India for the first time, earning Lord Minto the label 'Father of Communal Electorate'?

q: किस ब्रिटिश प्रस्ताव (अगस्त 1940, वायसराय लॉर्ड लिनलिथगो द्वारा जारी) में ब्रिटिश सरकार ने पहली बार स्पष्ट रूप से भारतीयों द्वारा अपना संविधान बनाने के अधिकार को स्वीकार किया?
e: The August Offer (8 August 1940) for the first time explicitly conceded the demand for a Constituent Assembly (mainly of Indians) after the War, though Congress rejected it (अगस्त प्रस्ताव, 1940).
qe: Under which British proposal (August 1940, issued by Viceroy Lord Linlithgow) did the British Government for the FIRST time explicitly recognize the right of Indians to frame their own Constitution (subject to Dominion Status after WWII)?

q: भारतीय संविधान के अनुच्छेद 23 और 24, जो मानव दुर्व्यापार, बलात् श्रम (बेगार) और 14 वर्ष से कम आयु के बच्चों के कारखानों/खदानों में नियोजन पर रोक लगाते हैं, किस मौलिक अधिकार का निर्माण करते हैं?
e: Articles 23 and 24 guarantee the Right against Exploitation (शोषण के विरुद्ध अधिकार).
qe: Articles 23 and 24 of the Indian Constitution, prohibiting human trafficking, forced labour ('begar'), and employment of children below 14 years in factories/mines, constitute which Fundamental Right?

q: भारतीय संविधान की कौन-सी अनुसूची संघ और राज्यों के बीच विधायी शक्तियों को तीन सूचियों — संघ सूची, राज्य सूची और समवर्ती सूची — में विभाजित करती है?
e: The Seventh Schedule (Article 246) contains the Union List, State List, and Concurrent List; Residuary powers belong to Parliament under Article 248 (सातवीं अनुसूची में तीन सूचियाँ हैं).
qe: Which Schedule of the Indian Constitution divides legislative powers between the Union and the States into three lists — Union List, State List, and Concurrent List?

q: भारतीय नागरिकता (भाग II, अनुच्छेद 5–11) की कौन-सी प्रमुख विशेषता ब्रिटिश संविधान से ली गई है?
o: Single Citizenship for the entire country
e: Unlike the USA and Switzerland (which have dual citizenship), India provides Single Citizenship throughout the country (एकल नागरिकता ब्रिटेन से ली गई है). Exam Boosters: (1) Article 11 empowers Parliament to regulate citizenship (Citizenship Act, 1955).
qe: Which feature of Indian Citizenship (Part II, Articles 5–11) was borrowed from the British Constitution?
oe: Single Citizenship for the entire country

q: निम्नलिखित में से कौन-सा राज्य का नीति निदेशक तत्व (DPSP) 'गांधीवादी सिद्धांत' के अंतर्गत वर्गीकृत किया जाता है?
o: Organization of Village Panchayats (Article 40) and Promotion of Cottage Industries (Article 43)
Promotion of International Peace and Security (Article 51)
e: Gandhian DPSPs include Art. 40 (Village Panchayats), Art. 43 (Cottage industries), Art. 43B (Co-operative societies), Art. 46 (SC/ST welfare), Art. 47 (Prohibition of intoxicating drinks), and Art. 48 (Prohibition of cow slaughter). Art. 44, 50, 51 are Liberal-Intellectual principles.
qe: Which of the following Directive Principles of State Policy (DPSP) is classified as a 'Gandhian Principle'?
oe: Organization of Village Panchayats (Article 40) and Promotion of Cottage Industries (Article 43)
Promotion of International Peace and Security (Article 51)

q: किस संविधान संशोधन अधिनियम द्वारा नीति निदेशक तत्वों में अनुच्छेद 39A (समान न्याय एवं निःशुल्क विधिक सहायता) तथा अनुच्छेद 43A (उद्योगों के प्रबंधन में कर्मकारों की भागीदारी) जोड़े गए?
e: The 42nd Amendment Act, 1976 added 4 new DPSPs: Art. 39(f) (healthy development of children), Art. 39A (free legal aid), Art. 43A (workers' participation), and Art. 48A (environment/forests/wildlife) (42वें संविधान संशोधन, 1976 द्वारा).
qe: Which Constitutional Amendment Act inserted Article 39A (Equal justice and free legal aid) and Article 43A (Participation of workers in management of industries) into the Directive Principles?

q: भारतीय संविधान के अनुच्छेद 64 के अंतर्गत राज्यसभा का पदेन सभापति कौन होता है?
e: The Vice-President of India is the ex-officio Chairman of the Rajya Sabha (भारत के उपराष्ट्रपति राज्यसभा के पदेन सभापति होते हैं). Exam Boosters: (1) Vice-President is elected by an electoral college of ALL members (elected + nominated) of both Lok Sabha and Rajya Sabha (State MLAs do NOT participate).
qe: Who serves as the ex-officio Chairman of the Rajya Sabha (Council of States) under Article 64 of the Indian Constitution?

q: 1970 के दशक के उत्तरार्ध और 1980 के दशक में भारत में 'जनहित याचिका' (PIL) के अग्रदूत के रूप में किसे जाना जाता है?
o: Justice P. N. Bhagwati (along with Justice V. R. Krishna Iyer)
e: Justice P. N. Bhagwati and Justice V. R. Krishna Iyer pioneered PIL in India (relaxing the strict rule of 'locus standi' so any public-spirited citizen can approach courts for the disadvantaged) (न्यायमूर्ति पी. एन. भगवती को भारत में PIL का जनक कहा जाता है).
qe: Who is universally recognized as the pioneer of 'Public Interest Litigation (PIL)' in India during the late 1970s and 1980s?
oe: Justice P. N. Bhagwati (along with Justice V. R. Krishna Iyer)

q: भारत के किस राष्ट्रपति ने 1986 में 'भारतीय डाकघर (संशोधन) विधेयक' पर अनिश्चितकाल तक कोई निर्णय न लेकर प्रसिद्ध रूप से 'जेबी वीटो' (Pocket Veto) का प्रयोग किया था?
o: Dr. A. P. J. Abdul Kalam
e: President Giani Zail Singh used the Pocket Veto in 1986 on the Indian Post Office (Amendment) Bill because the Indian Constitution prescribes NO time limit for the President to act on a bill under Article 111 (ज्ञानी जैल सिंह ने 1986 में पॉकेट वीटो का प्रयोग किया).
qe: Which President of India famously exercised the 'Pocket Veto' in 1986 by keeping the Indian Post Office (Amendment) Bill pending indefinitely without giving or withholding assent?
oe: Dr. A. P. J. Abdul Kalam

q: भारतीय संविधान के किस अनुच्छेद के अंतर्गत किसी राज्य का राज्यपाल राज्य विधानमंडल द्वारा पारित कतिपय विधेयकों को राष्ट्रपति के विचारार्थ आरक्षित रख सकता है?
e: Under Article 200, a Governor may assent, withhold assent, return (non-money) bills, or reserve a bill for the President's consideration (mandatory if the bill endangers the position of the High Court) (अनुच्छेद 200 — राज्यपाल द्वारा विधेयक राष्ट्रपति के विचारार्थ आरक्षित करना).
qe: Under which Article of the Indian Constitution is the Governor of a State empowered to reserve certain bills passed by the State Legislature for the consideration of the President?

q:
भारतीय संसद में 'अविश्वास प्रस्ताव' के संदर्भ में निम्नलिखित कथनों पर विचार कीजिए:
कथन I: इसे केवल लोकसभा में ही लाया जा सकता है और स्वीकृति हेतु कम से कम 50 सदस्यों का समर्थन आवश्यक है।
कथन II: मंत्रिपरिषद के विरुद्ध इसे लाने के लिए विशिष्ट संवैधानिक कारण बताना अनिवार्य है।
उपर्युक्त कथनों में से कौन-सा/से सही है/हैं?
e: Statement I is correct (Rule 198 of Lok Sabha Rules). Statement II is INCORRECT because a No-Confidence Motion need NOT state any specific reasons (unlike a Censure Motion, which must state specific grounds) (अविश्वास प्रस्ताव में कारण बताना अनिवार्य नहीं है).
qe:
Consider the following statements regarding 'No-Confidence Motion' in the Indian Parliament:
Statement I: It can be moved ONLY in the Lok Sabha and needs the support of at least 50 members to be admitted.
Statement II: It must explicitly state specific constitutional grounds or reasons for moving it against the Council of Ministers.
Which of the above statements is/are correct?

q: 74वें संविधान संशोधन अधिनियम, 1992 के अंतर्गत भारतीय संविधान में कौन-सी अनुसूची जोड़ी गई जिसमें नगरीय स्थानीय निकायों (नगरपालिकाओं) के लिए 18 विषय सूचीबद्ध हैं?
e: The 74th Amendment Act, 1992 added Part IX-A (Articles 243P–243ZG) and the Twelfth Schedule containing 18 municipal subjects (12वीं अनुसूची में नगरपालिकाओं के 18 विषय हैं). Exam Boosters: (1) Three types of Urban Local Bodies: Nagar Panchayat (transitional area), Municipal Council (smaller urban area), and Municipal Corporation (larger urban area).
qe: Under the 74th Constitutional Amendment Act, 1992, which Schedule was added to the Indian Constitution listing 18 functional items for Urban Local Bodies (Municipalities)?

q: भारतीय संविधान के अनुच्छेद 243A के अंतर्गत 'ग्राम सभा' (ग्राम स्तर पर प्रत्यक्ष लोकतंत्र की आधारभूत संस्था) का निर्माण किससे होता है?
o: Only the elected Sarpanch and Ward Panches
All residents of the village regardless of age
All persons registered in the electoral rolls relating to a village within the Panchayat area
State Government revenue officials posted in the block
e: Gram Sabha consists of ALL registered voters (electoral roll members) within the Gram Panchayat area (पंचायत क्षेत्र की मतदाता सूची में पंजीकृत सभी व्यक्ति ग्राम सभा के सदस्य होते हैं).
qe: Under Article 243A of the Indian Constitution, who constitutes the 'Gram Sabha' (the foundational body of direct democracy at the village level)?
oe: Only the elected Sarpanch and Ward Panches
All residents of the village regardless of age
All persons registered in the electoral rolls relating to a village within the Panchayat area
State Government revenue officials posted in the block

q: भाग IX-A के किस अनुच्छेद के अंतर्गत प्रत्येक राज्य को जिले में पंचायतों और नगरपालिकाओं द्वारा तैयार योजनाओं को समेकित करने हेतु 'जिला योजना समिति' (DPC) का गठन करना अनिवार्य है?
e: Article 243ZD mandates a District Planning Committee (4/5th members elected by elected members of Zila Parishad and Municipalities), while Article 243ZE mandates a Metropolitan Planning Committee (अनुच्छेद 243ZD — जिला योजना समिति).
qe: Under which Article of Part IX-A is every State mandated to constitute a 'District Planning Committee (DPC)' to consolidate plans prepared by both Panchayats and Municipalities in the district?

q: भारतीय संविधान के किस अनुच्छेद के अंतर्गत संघ लोक सेवा आयोग (UPSC) की स्थापना का प्रावधान है?
e: Article 315 (Part XIV, Articles 315–323) provides for UPSC and State Public Service Commissions (अनुच्छेद 315 — संघ एवं राज्य लोक सेवा आयोग). Exam Boosters: (1) UPSC Chairman & members are appointed by the President for 6 years or until age 65 (State PSC: 6 years or age 62).
qe: Under which Article of the Indian Constitution is the Union Public Service Commission (UPSC) established?

q: किस संविधान संशोधन अधिनियम द्वारा अनुच्छेद 338B जोड़कर राष्ट्रीय पिछड़ा वर्ग आयोग (NCBC) को संवैधानिक दर्जा प्रदान किया गया?
e: The 102nd Constitutional Amendment Act, 2018 inserted Article 338B granting constitutional status to NCBC (102वें संविधान संशोधन, 2018 द्वारा NCBC को संवैधानिक दर्जा मिला). Exam Boosters: (1) 89th Amendment (2003) bifurcated the combined SC/ST commission into NCSC (Art. 338) and NCST (Art. 338A); (2) 103rd Amendment (2019) introduced 10% EWS reservation; (3) 106th Amendment (2023) is the Nari Shakti Vandan Adhiniyam (33% Women's Reservation).
qe: Which Constitutional Amendment Act granted constitutional status to the National Commission for Backward Classes (NCBC) by inserting Article 338B?

q: भारत की इलेक्ट्रॉनिक वोटिंग मशीन (EVM) प्रणाली के संदर्भ में 'VVPAT' का पूर्ण रूप क्या है?
e: VVPAT stands for Voter Verified Paper Audit Trail, allowing voters to visually verify their cast vote on a printed paper slip for ~7 seconds (वोटर वेरिफाइड पेपर ऑडिट ट्रेल). Exam Boosters: (1) First used in Noksen Assembly constituency (Nagaland, 2013) and deployed across 100% of polling stations from the 2019 Lok Sabha elections; (2) NOTA ('None of the Above') was introduced in 2013 following the Supreme Court's PUCL verdict.
qe: What does 'VVPAT' stand for in the context of India's Electronic Voting Machine (EVM) system?

q: किस समिति (1990) ने भारत में प्रमुख चुनाव सुधारों जैसे मतदाता फोटो पहचान पत्र (EPIC), इलेक्ट्रॉनिक वोटिंग मशीन और बूथ कैप्चरिंग पर रोक की सिफारिश की थी?
e: Dinesh Goswami Committee (1990) made landmark recommendations on Electoral Reforms (दिनेश गोस्वामी समिति, 1990). Exam Boosters: (1) Indrajit Gupta Committee (1998) dealt with State Funding of Elections; (2) Tarkunde Committee (1974–75) recommended lowering voting age to 18; (3) Santhanam Committee (1962) led to the establishment of the Central Vigilance Commission (CVC, 1964).
qe: Which committee (1990) recommended major electoral reforms in India including Electors' Photo Identity Cards (EPIC), electronic voting machines, and banning booth capturing?

q: संयुक्त राष्ट्र सुरक्षा परिषद (UNSC) में कुल कितने सदस्य होते हैं और इसके अस्थायी सदस्यों का कार्यकाल कितना होता है?
e: UNSC has 15 members: 5 Permanent (P5: USA, UK, France, Russia, China) and 10 Non-Permanent elected by UNGA for 2-year terms (UNSC में 15 सदस्य: 5 स्थायी + 10 अस्थायी, कार्यकाल 2 वर्ष).
qe: How many total members are there in the United Nations Security Council (UNSC), and what is the term of its non-permanent members?

q: हेनरी फेयोल के लोक प्रशासन/प्रबंधन के शास्त्रीय सिद्धांतों में 'आदेश की एकता' (Unity of Command) का क्या अर्थ है?
o: All employees must earn identical salaries.
An employee should receive orders from and be accountable to ONE immediate superior only.
All departments must be merged into a single ministry.
Decisions must be taken unanimously by all citizens.
e: Unity of Command (आदेश की एकता) means each subordinate receives orders from only one boss to avoid confusion and conflicting instructions. Exam Boosters: (1) 'Span of Control' (नियंत्रण का क्षेत्र) refers to the number of subordinates a superior can effectively supervise; (2) Henri Fayol gave 14 Principles of Management and POCCC (Planning, Organizing, Commanding, Coordinating, Controlling).
qe: In Henri Fayol's classical principles of Public Administration/Management, what does the principle of 'Unity of Command' (आदेश की एकता) mean?
oe: All employees must earn identical salaries.
An employee should receive orders from and be accountable to ONE immediate superior only.
All departments must be merged into a single ministry.
Decisions must be taken unanimously by all citizens.

q: भारत की 'लुक ईस्ट पॉलिसी' (1991 में पी. वी. नरसिम्हा राव द्वारा प्रारंभ और 2014 में 'एक्ट ईस्ट पॉलिसी' में उन्नत) मुख्य रूप से किस क्षेत्रीय समूह के साथ रणनीतिक, आर्थिक व सांस्कृतिक संबंधों को सुदृढ़ करने पर केंद्रित है?
o: ASEAN and the wider Indo-Pacific region
e: Look East / Act East Policy focuses on ASEAN (Association of Southeast Asian Nations, est. 1967) and the broader Indo-Pacific (Japan, South Korea, Australia) through the 3Cs: Commerce, Culture, and Connectivity (आसियान और हिंद-प्रशांत क्षेत्र).
qe: India's 'Look East Policy' (initiated in 1991 under P. V. Narasimha Rao and upgraded to 'Act East Policy' in 2014) primarily aims to deepen strategic, economic, and cultural engagement with which regional grouping?
oe: ASEAN and the wider Indo-Pacific region
